## Appearance

As a boy, Gilbert is tall with curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and a mouth twisted into a teasing smile. As a young man, he grows into a tall, frank-faced fellow with broad shoulders and clear, straightforward eyes. When working intensely or recovering from severe illness, he can appear pale and thin, and people remark that he looks quite young for a doctor.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 c29 P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 c39 P22](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0022), [v4 c2 P14](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0014)_

## Personality

Gilbert is ambitious, hardworking, clever, and good-natured. He possesses a strong sense of humor and an engaging, friendly demeanour. He is deeply thoughtful, kind, and self-sacrificing, demonstrated by his willingness to step aside for others and his devotion to those he loves.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v3 c25 P25](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0025), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

## History

After living in Alberta for three years with his ailing father, Gilbert returns to Avonlea to resume his schooling. He quickly establishes an intense academic rivalry with Anne Shirley. After attending Queen's Academy together, he selflessly surrenders his position at the Avonlea school to Anne so she can stay near Marilla, electing to teach at White Sands instead. He co-founds the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and acts as its president before entering Redmond College alongside Anne. During his freshman year at Redmond, he leads his class to victory in the Arts Rush, serves as Freshman Class president, and captains the football team. Gilbert eventually confesses his love to Anne, but she refuses his marriage proposal, after which he steps back to maintain a courteous distance. Following a grueling academic year in which he earns High Honors and the Cooper Prize, he falls critically ill with typhoid fever; upon learning that Anne is not engaged to Roy Gardner, he recovers rapidly and asks her again, winning her heart. After completing his medical studies, Gilbert marries Anne in the Green Gables orchard and moves to Four Winds Harbor to take over his great-uncle Dr. David Blythe's practice. He settles with Anne in a little house by the harbor, earns a reputation as a devoted physician by saving patients like Rhoda Allonby, and eventually plans a move into Glen St. Mary as his family and medical practice grow.

## Background by volume

- spent three years in Alberta with his sick father  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

- rescued Anne Shirley from a dory pile on the pond  <sub>[v1 c28 P26](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0026), [v1 c28 P38](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0038), [v4 c3 P63](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0063)</sub>
- co-founded the Avonlea Village Improvement Society  <sub>[v2 c1 P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v3 c2 P5](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0005)</sub>
- taught school in White Sands for a year  <sub>[v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c25 P70](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0070)</sub>
